subject: REP-001 replicates this core's basis in DIRECTION across three independent draws, but not in MAGNITUDE
why_this_was_registered_in_advance: REP001_PREREG.md prediction 5 committed to recording the outcome in THIS file, whichever way it fell, precisely so a favourable result could not be reported only in its own results document while an unfavourable one was buried.

what_was_tested.design: Two genuinely new training draws (selection seeds 23 and 29) of the identical RRP-015 control recipe, trained from exact Supa, plus the seed-17 anchor. For each draw, BOTH the full FP32 update and its k=0.25 magnitude-pruned variant were measured, so every comparison is paired within draw and only the mask differs.
what_was_tested.draw_independence: 384 distinct parents per draw; pairwise parent overlap 35, 35 and 41 of 384, consistent with independent sampling.

result_direction_replicates.prediction: retained >= its own control AND long context >= its own control, in 2 of 2 new draws
result_direction_replicates.outcome: HELD, 2 of 2 new draws, and 3 of 3 including the anchor
result_direction_replicates.reading: Pruning never made either preservation endpoint worse in any draw.

result_magnitude_does_not_replicate.consequence: This core's own headline gain of +2 over its BF16 sibling, and +7 over its FP32 control, must NOT be quoted as an expected effect. The defensible statement is 'never worse on either preservation endpoint, sometimes substantially better'.
result_magnitude_does_not_replicate.drafting_weakness_recorded: REP-001's predictions 2-4 were written as >=, so seed 23's exactly-zero long-context delta satisfies them. The letter held where the substance was null. A minimum effect size should have been registered.

the_more_useful_finding.claim: Magnitude pruning behaves as a REPAIR that pays most where the damage is worst, not as a uniform gain.
the_more_useful_finding.evidence: Ordering draws by control damage: control long context 157 / 152 / 144 gives pruning gains of +7 / +0 / +15.
the_more_useful_finding.worst_draw: Seed 29's control is the only arm in this programme with statistically detected long-context damage: 144/256, paired exact McNemar p = 0.0115 against Supa's 161, with abstention collapsed to 4/64. Its k=0.25 variant scores 159/256 at p = 0.8450 and restores abstention to 12/64.
the_more_useful_finding.strict_dominance_in_that_draw: At seed 29 pruning is better on EVERY endpoint: acquisition +2, arithmetic +3, strict +6, retained +4, long context +15, abstention +8. No trade at all.
the_more_useful_finding.why_it_matters: The failure mode pruning protects against - a draw that quietly destroys long context and abstention - is exactly the one the registered gate cannot see.

what_this_means_for_this_core_s_own_numb.acquisition: Trustworthy. Control acquisition across three independent draws spans only 7 of 384 (228-235).
what_this_means_for_this_core_s_own_numb.retention_and_long_context: MUCH weaker than the single-draw record implies. Control long context spans 13 rows across draws (144-157) and strict arithmetic spans 13 (51-64). A single-draw retention figure is close to uninformative.
what_this_means_for_this_core_s_own_numb.explicit_caveat: This core's recorded retained 41/47, long context 164/256 and literal UNKNOWN 12/64 are ONE draw's values. They should be read as one sample from a distribution whose spread is larger than the differences being claimed, not as the core's properties.
what_this_means_for_this_core_s_own_numb.applies_equally_to: Rineya-Titan-Experimental-1.0.0-devfreeze, whose retention figures are also single-draw.

replicates_an_older_finding: RRP-013 concluded 'acquisition never varies; what varies is retention, not learning.' REP-001 reproduces that on the new selection-admissible bank with genuinely independent draws.

unchanged.note: Three draws cannot pin a rate, and every long-context and abstention number remains report-only on a SPENT suite.
